panels.scene_en: a dense green forest with sunbeams falling between tall trees onto a mossy path

bubbles.text: Hustý les. Mezi stromy svítí slunce.

panels.scene_en: Terezka walks along the forest path and points at tiny footprints in the mud, her grey cat Misa walking ahead

bubbles.text: Míšo, někdo tu nechal stopy. Pojďme je sledovat!

panels.scene_en: Terezka squats by an old mossy tree stump and holds up a tiny red scarf she found
a wise brown owl on a branch above the stump looks down with big round eyes

bubbles.text: Húú… tomu, kdo se bojí být sám.

panels.scene_en: a tiny shy gnome with a pointy brown hat peeks out of a hollow in the tree stump

bubbles.text: Můj šátek! Děkuju. Ztratil jsem se.

panels.scene_en: Terezka kneels kindly in front of the tiny gnome, her grey cat rubs against the gnome's little leg

bubbles.text: Neboj se. Míša a já tě dovedeme domů.

panels.scene_en: at a tiny house built into the roots of a tree, the gnome gives Terezka a handful of forest berries

bubbles.text: Jste nejlepší kamarádky. Tady máte lesní bobule.

panels.scene_en: close-up of Misa the grey cat with closed eyes, purring contentedly
